notes: Relay witness (Urdu -> Turkish). The Turkish Tefhîm team (İnsan Yayınları) included Ali Bulaç: its meal lines are ~73% identical to MEAL-BULAC over S1, S22, S87-114, so the two are not independent witnesses. 3 merged verse groups stored once as a..a_end. 4 host verse-number prefixes (e.g. "6, 7.", "(6-7)") removed from the text; the range is in a..a_end. 1 ayat missing on the primary host filled from a cross witness (field host_flag): 17:71. Cross-check over S1, S22, S87-114 (primary mealler.org "Tefhim-ul Kuran") - fawazahmed0/quran-api tur-tefhimulkuran: n=373, exact 3.2%, loose 100.0%, sim 1.0; â/î/û in 5.4% of ayat (primary 5.4%).
